exact_definitions: def observerDistance (u v : FourVector) : Real := observerNorm (u - v)
def VanishingSlopeModulus (omega : Real → Real) : Prop := Filter.Tendsto omega (nhdsWithin (0 : Real) (Set.Ioi (0 : Real))) (nhds (0 : Real))

def BoundedSourcePair (R L b2 b3 epsilon chi : Real) : Prop := 0 < epsilon ∧ 0 < chi ∧ chi ≤ R ∧ 0 < b2 ∧ 0 < b3 ∧ observerNorm (uChi chi) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.cosh (2 * R)) ∧ observerNorm (uChi 0) ≤ Real.sqrt (Real.cosh (2 * R)) ∧ rateAmplitude (boostedB epsilon chi b2 b3) ≤ L ∧ rateAmplitude (boostedB epsilon 0 b2 b3) ≤ L

def UniformSlopeVelocityBound (R L b2 b3 : Real) (omega : Real → Real) : Prop := ∀ epsilon chi : Real, BoundedSourcePair R L b2 b3 epsilon chi → observerDistance (uChi chi) (uChi 0) ≤ omega (coefficientError epsilon chi b2 b3)
exact_target_signatures: theorem observerDistance_uChi_pos (chi : Real) (hchi : 0 < chi) : 0 < observerDistance (uChi chi) (uChi 0)
theorem coefficientError_pos (epsilon chi b2 b3 : Real) (he : 0 < epsilon) (hchi : 0 < chi) : 0 < coefficientError epsilon chi b2 b3

theorem no_uniform_slope_only_velocity_modulus (epsilon0 chi R b2 b3 : Real) (he0 : 0 < epsilon0) (hchi : 0 < chi) (hchiR : chi ≤ R) (h2 : 0 < b2) (h3 : 0 < b3) : ¬ ∃ omega : Real → Real, VanishingSlopeModulus omega ∧ UniformSlopeVelocityBound R (rateCap epsilon0 R b2 b3) b2 b3 omega
